README.md.summary: This `README.md` file serves as the project overview and central documentation hub for "The Legend of War," outlining its architecture, module dependencies, and development roadmap.

definitions.py.summary: `definitions.py` stores configuration data, specifically defining the `plugins` list and `special_repos` dictionary. It serves as a central data constants file for tracking project repositories.

devstack/README.md.summary: This README documents the local Docker-based development and testing stack for `firecord`, providing a Redis node and multiple client nodes for local integration testing.

devstack/run-smoke.sh.summary: This script executes a minimal end-to-end devstack smoke test, verifying cross-node consistency via Docker Compose and Redis. It defines `redis_get` and `cleanup` to support the test pipeline.

install_server.sh.summary: `install_server.sh` is a deployment script that provisions the server environment by installing system packages, runtimes, databases, and development tools via `nala`, `pacstall`, and `apt`. It acts as the primary infrastructure setup script for the project.

devstack/docker-compose.yml.summary: This file defines a Docker Compose configuration for the local development stack, orchestrating a shared `redis` service and standalone Java nodes (`node-a`, `node-b`) for testing.

notes/advancements LoW algorithm.txt.summary: This documentation file outlines the design and graph-to-tree conversion algorithm for map advancements using DFS/BFS traversal and helper nodes. It serves as a conceptual blueprint for structuring map progression data.

notes/Mechanics & Systems for Combat.txt.summary: This design document specifies core combat mechanics, including directional damage modifiers and vision-based spotting rules. It serves as a design reference for the project's combat system implementation.

manage.py.summary: `manage.py` acts as a command-line interface script for managing, pulling, building, and developing plugins for Legend of Phoenix. It utilizes Python's `argparse` module to execute these administrative development tasks.

notes/archive/The Legend of War - New He.summary: This file documents the "new Heros" update plan for "The Legend of War," outlining gameplay changes, new features, and bug fixes. It serves as a historical project roadmap and design document.

notes/archive/The Legend of Phoenix.md.summary: This documentation file outlines the project roadmap and content planning for "The Legend of Phoenix." It serves as an archived planning document for development milestones and video production.

notes/archive/README.md.summary: This documentation file indexes outdated and historical project notes, serving as a reference directory pointing to current wiki equivalents.
